multi-modal-cache-factories.name: vllm/multimodal/cache/factories.py
multi-modal-cache-factories.summary: Chooses the multimodal processor cache: none (non-multimodal model or --mm-processor-cache-gb 0), processor-only (no IPC with several API processes or DP), else --mm-processor-cache-type (lru by default) with a mirrored P1 receiver in the engine.

sampling-params.name: SamplingParams
sampling-params.summary: vllm.SamplingParams: built by the request's to_sampling_params in the API process (from_optional, __post_init__, _verify_args); the engine's InputProcessor later calls verify() against the model config.

multi-modal-cache-factories.engine-recei.summary: engine_receiver_cache_from_config: the engine-core process gets the LRU receiver only for cache type lru (none for processor_only, shm or no cache).

sampling-params.update-from-tokenizer.summary: SamplingParams.update_from_tokenizer (the engine's InputProcessor calls it): each bad word is encoded without special tokens, bare and with a leading space; the bare form must give a token, the spaced form counts only when it starts with a different token of the same length; past VLLM_MAX_NUM_BAD_WORDS, or with an id outside the vocabulary, it is a VLLMValidationError naming bad_words.
